description:
pattern     perspective-grid / trust_badges
surface     dark
kit         signature centered above heading
form        Columns 1–12 introduce the honors block, unfolding into a 3x2 grid of glass cards featuring interactive 3D perspective tilt, illuminated top icons, milestone headlines, and concise impact summaries. On mobile, cards render in a vertical stack with touch tilt disabled.
copy
  eyebrow      RECOGNITION & HONORS
  heading      Achievements & Milestones
  card-1-title Academic Excellence
  card-1-desc  Consistently maintained top percentile academic standings across advanced software engineering, database systems, and networking modules.
  card-2-title Leadership Impact
  card-2-desc  Elected to represent student cohorts, advocating for academic resources, peer well-being, and faculty collaboration initiatives.
  card-3-title Technology Innovations
  card-3-desc  Developed automated departmental utility tools that streamlined project submissions and internal scheduling across student bodies.
  card-4-title Competitive Hackathons
  card-4-desc  Secured podium positions in inter-university technology hackathons by architecting rapid-prototype IoT and web solutions.
  card-5-title Professional Certifications
  card-5-desc  Earned verified industry credentials in cloud infrastructure, containerized deployments, and enterprise full-stack development.
  card-6-title Community Volunteering
  card-6-desc  Dedicated over 200 hours mentoring junior undergraduates in introductory programming, version control, and career planning.
motion      Header enters at 60ms; tilt cards stagger at 80ms; dynamic 3D rotation responds to mouse coordinates at 60fps.
plan check  heading placed; set of 6 3D tilt cards (academic, leadership, technology, competitions, certifications, volunteering) each with an icon/image, title and short description placed.
layout_description: Three-column, two-row symmetrical grid of interactive 3D cards beneath a centered section header.
